name: Mandukparni
actions: Traditionally used as a brain tonic (medhya)
traditionalUses: Leaves in salads and chutneys in some regions
kitchenUse: Fresh leaves are eaten in chutneys and salads in some regions; as a remedy it is taken as juice or powder.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary

cautions.note: Rare cases of liver injury have been reported, usually resolving after stopping.
Not enough is known; avoid medicinal amounts in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.
Can cause allergic skin rashes when applied.

evidence.summary: Some trials suggest it may help leg vein problems and wound healing; evidence for memory is weak.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
